InitStep.outputLabel: locked plan, one slot per chapter

CurateWaveStep.waitLabel: Waits for every chapter's beat-splitting run to finish.

DirectorGate.waitLabel: Stops here. The director has to rule on the flagged beats before anything is translated; it nudges once a day until they do.

ProduceWaveStep.waitLabel: Waits for every chapter's translation run to finish.

QaGate.outputLabel: human approval to write the vault
QaGate.waitLabel: Stops here. Someone has to accept the quality scorecard before these chapters may enter the book.

HarvestStep.outputLabel: chapter markdown in the book folder + count

PrintStep.outputLabel: 6x9 interior PDF + page count + preflight verdict

ProofGate.waitLabel: Stops here. Someone has to sign off the proof; it refuses to even ask until the chapters, manuscript and interior all exist.

RecoveryGate.outputLabel: re-entry at the stage an operator names
RecoveryGate.waitLabel: Stops here. The volume is parked until someone says where to restart it.
